references.text: Lot offered his two virgin daughters to the men of Sodom in a similar way, to protect his guests from abuse.
Lot asked the men of Sodom not to commit this evil deed, using the same wording about not acting wickedly.
The expression 'folly in Israel' (nevalah) is used to describe serious moral offenses.
The same Hebrew expression 'nevalah' (folly/shameful act) is used regarding Achan's sin against Israel.
Later in the account, this event is referred back to as 'shameful folly in Israel'.
Tamar uses the same expression 'folly in Israel' when she tries to stop Amnon from raping her.
